root_rule: sha256(recipe_id + LF + LF-joined ordered window artifact shas + LF); ordered = chronological cutoff order, new windows BEFORE the existing ladder (append-only backwards)
recipe_id_rule: recipe_match.recipe_fingerprint over the window artifact's recipe projection

cadence_measurement.convention: pure N-calendar-day arithmetic grid, no NYSE-holiday adjustment; OOS windows use panel trading dates

vintage_seam.decision: DOCUMENT THE VINTAGE SEAM — do NOT regenerate the 43-window ladder
vintage_seam.decision_rationale: The production lineage stamps bind the ACTUAL artifacts in the WF manifest; regenerating them on the Aug vintage would break that tie and create a third parallel corpus. The whole ladder is already retrospective (built June-July 2026 for 2023-2026 cutoffs), so extending on the current vintage with the seam recorded is methodologically the same object — the seam makes the June-vs-Aug input drift first-class instead of silent. (Operator decision, 2026-08-02.)
